label: At D2, raised after a1-S1 rewarded and by S1-good belief; lowered after S2 unrewarded.
short_terms: (phase == D2) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase==D2)*(prev_state==2)*(prev_reward==0) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo
terms: (phase == D2) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 u") ;; (phase == D2)*(tv("reward",-2)==1)*(tv("state",-2)==1) ;; (phase == D2) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (action == 1) ;; (phase==D2)*(prev_state==2)*(prev_reward==0)
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 39 is saturated by phase (about -0.97 at D1, +0.98 at GO, -0.7 at D2), and timing explains 97% of variance. Nearly all residual variance is at D2. There it is pushed up when the previous trial was a1 -> S1 rewarded (+0.24 to +0.36), pushed down when the previous trial reached S2 and went unrewarded (-0.22 to -0.29), and also follows the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good. So at D2 it tracks evidence that S1/a1 pays, mostly from the last outcome. The free fit adds this trial s a1 choice with the rare S2 transition at D2 (higher), an S1 reward two trials back, and a small D1 bump after a2 -> S1 unrewarded. These take dev R^2 beyond timing from 0.63 to 0.67. D1 and GO residuals are small. No future or model-output variables are used.

issues: The 'S2 unrewarded' part of the label is more specific than the data supports. Replacing (prev_state==2)*(prev_reward==0) with plain (prev_reward==0) scores test 0.619 against 0.621. In the residual table a2 S1 u (-0.177) is as low as a1 S2 u (-0.178), so any unrewarded previous trial lowers D2. S2-unrewarded is the lowest group (-0.24 for a2 S2 u), but the difference is small.

The short form misses one pattern in the current trial: at D2, a1 -> S2 rare raises the value strongly (choice x state residual +0.28; worst-fit windows show about 0.0 actual against -0.7 predicted after a1 S2R). Adding (phase==D2)*(action==1)*(state==2) as a 4th term lifts test from 0.621 to 0.642, but the term does not replace any of the existing three (swapping it in gives 0.49 to 0.54).
There is a small D1 bump after a2 S1 u (+0.126 under-predicted) that no term covers. It is minor in variance because D1 is saturated near -0.97.
Some D2 cells are systematically over-predicted: after a1 S2 r (-0.116) and after a1 S1 u (-0.094). The model lowers D2 after any non-a1-S1-r outcome, which the belief_lo term only partly captures.

Every term is needed: a1 S1 r alone scores 0.42, belief_lo alone 0.30, a1 S1 r with belief_lo 0.47, and the full 3-term form 0.62 (dev 0.63). The terms are interpretable rather than curve-fitting. No future or model-output variables are used.
